cases.name: a dragged row shows an XOR outline that follows the pointer; dropped on another drive's window it is copied there after Copy is chosen under a "Copying 1/1" window, and the target lists it
Move on a drive icon: the verified copy keeps the type (USR), then the source is scratched without a second question
a name that exists on the target (the drive answers 63) asks Replace, Skip or Stop over the progress window; Skip, the default, leaves both files unchanged
Replace scratches the target (S0:NAME, one file scratched) and copies again, compared as any copy
Cancel in the question opens and changes nothing
Esc during a copy stops it after the chunk in hand; the partial target stays, is said to, and is listed
a target that changes after writing fails the reopened comparison; the source is kept
with Confirm copies off in Preferences (gm_confirm bit 1), a dropped row is copied without the question
with Confirm overwrites off (gm_confirm bit 3), a name on the target is scratched and copied again without the Replace question
an IEC file dropped on a USB window is copied into that folder (context 1) and listed there
onto USB, FILE_STAT finds the name first; Replace deletes it (DELETE_FILE) and copies the new bytes
Move from USB to a drive: ".PRG" becomes a PRG file; DELETE_FILE then removes the source
any other USB file becomes a SEQ file under its own name
a USB name that does not fit a drive, and a folder dropped on a drive, are refused before anything is opened
USB to USB: the target is opened on the other DOS context and listed in its window
